interface IShape
{
    string Name { get; }
    double Area { get; }
}

record Circle(double Radius) : IShape
{
    public string Name => "circle";
    public double Area => Math.PI * Radius * Radius;
}

record Rect(double W, double H) : IShape
{
    public string Name => "rect";
    public double Area => W * H;
}
